model_provenance.candidate_artifact_limitation: External quantized weights/calibration artifacts are not discovered automatically; supply their separate manifest before claiming full candidate reproducibility.

boundaries: Dispatch scopes enclose synchronous pool.run/run_group including transport, scheduling, SV worker evaluation and waits. Eval surrounds both clock edges. Residual includes main SV arithmetic, generated wrapper copies and coordinator work, NOT pure host overhead. Outside-eval wall includes IPC and Python transport. Group timings cannot split constituent Q/K/V or gate/up.
limitations: Dynamic enabled/disabled comparison only measures instrumentation effects inside same executable; compiling timers can change code layout. Two resident models, OS caches warm, host drift possible. Diagnostic attribution, not optimization speed claim.
